claims.assertion: Za’el presents Earth’s artificial 3D experience as potentially strengthening but unnecessary; it may also compound trauma and suffering.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He says this view is not shared by everyone supporting the Matrix.

claims.assertion: Za’el says perspectives on victimhood vary, but people can act on present circumstances and alter their experienced path.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He encourages practical improvement while rejecting suffering as necessary.
